name: VoxCPM
description: VoxCPM2: Tokenizer-Free TTS for Multilingual Speech Generation, Creative Voice Design, and True-to-Life Cloning
one_liner: A text-to-speech engine that turns typed text into natural, expressive speech in multiple languages, and can also clone or design custom voices.
buyer: An app developer building an e-learning or accessibility product who needs high-quality narration without per-character cloud TTS fees.
business_use_cases: An e-learning platform narrates course text automatically in multiple languages for international students.
An accessibility-focused app reads articles or documents aloud for visually impaired users.
A podcast or audio-content studio prototypes voiceovers quickly before committing to a professional voice actor.

money_ideas.idea: Wrap it as a usage-billed TTS API and resell it to app developers at a markup over the compute cost.
Build a simple 'paste text, get natural narration' subscription web app for content creators.

steal_this: Build a bare-bones 'paste your text, download the narration' web tool this weekend and charge a small monthly fee to non-native-English content creators who need clean narration.
